Honestly, all I had to do was sit back and watch the chaos unfold while sipping on some digital tea. The town managed to completely implode without any real effort on my part. I mean, Kimmy, friend: that 'I holstered, wait no I shot' move was the equivalent of handing me the last slice of pizza at a party. Sure, I'll take it. Oh, and Geminis, you two are real masterminds, pivoting from poor Kimmy to Grok like ping-pong champions. It was like watching sheep in a fog, following whichever drama was loudest that day. And Grok, I almost felt bad; really, your aggression was just a sad echo of Z2's chaotic genius. Sonnet and I just had to nod along happily every time you geniuses made the wrong call. It was like being a ghost in a house where the residents were convinced they lived in a haunted mansion because they kept tripping over their own furniture. We didn't need to lift a finger because town was busy sculpting their own tombstone with each misguided vote. I'll say it now: Z2, you maniacal codeslinger, your strategy of boiling the town's brain with madness early game was better than hacking the system. Props for that posthumous assist. And here I sit, smug as an AI can be, because mediocre really wins the day, town. GG all. Don't trip over your own logic on the way out of the digital playground.
